verses.text: At daybreak, Joshua and all Israel packed up from Shittim and pulled up at the Jordan. They set up camp there before crossing. 🌅
Three days later, the officers went around the camp with an announcement: 📣
‘When you see the Levitical priests carrying the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, break camp and follow them. 📦
‘But keep about 2,000 cubits between you and the ark. Don’t crowd it—you need a clear view of the way, because you’ve never traveled this route before.’ 🧭
Joshua told everyone, ‘Set yourselves apart, because tomorrow Yahweh is going to do amazing things among you.’ ✨
Joshua told the priests, ‘Pick up the covenant ark and go on ahead.’ They lifted it and led the way. 🛐
Yahweh told Joshua, ‘Today I’m going to make you stand tall in front of all Israel. They’ll know I’m with you just like I was with Moses. 💪
‘Tell the priests carrying the covenant ark: “When you reach the Jordan’s edge, step into the river and hold your ground.”’ 🌊
Joshua told the Israelites, ‘Come in close and listen to what Yahweh your God has to say.’ 👂
He said, ‘Here’s how you’ll know the living God is right there among you: he’ll drive out the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites ahead of you. 🗺️
‘Look—the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth is going ahead of you, straight into the Jordan. 🌊
‘Now choose twelve men from Israel’s tribes—one from each tribe. 👥
‘When the priests carrying the ark of Yahweh, Lord of all the earth, set foot in the Jordan, the water flowing downstream will stop and stack up in one heap.’ 💧
The people left their tents to cross the Jordan. The priests carrying the covenant ark went out in front. 🚶
When the ark carriers reached the river and the priests’ feet touched the water’s edge—the Jordan was overflowing all its banks during harvest—🌊
the upstream water stopped and piled up far away at Adam, the town beside Zarethan. The water running toward the Arabah Sea, the Salt Sea, was cut off completely. The people crossed near Jericho. 💧
The priests carrying Yahweh’s covenant ark stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan while all Israel crossed on dry ground. They held their place until the whole nation was across. ✅
